title: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes — Phone Booking Fee Payment Reference
content:
A companion booking made through the reservations call center carries a phone booking fee, which the holder pays in person as its own charge entry of component phone booking fee on the ledger of the certificate or pass, naming the companion ticket of the booking. This applies on every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes.

The phone booking fee of a new booking is fixed only after the certificate's ledger carries the phone booking fee refund owed on every booking of that certificate that Crestline cancelled. So long as the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass does not yet show that refund for each such booking, the phone booking fee of the new booking is not fixed.

## Capability

`pay_companion_phone_booking_fee_ff06513e` lets the holder pay, in person, the phone booking fee of a companion booking made through the reservations call center. One run records one paid charge of component phone booking fee, dated today, on that certificate's or pass's charge history, linked to the companion ticket of the booking. The amount may be zero, in which case the fee is recorded as settled at zero. The holder's companion charges rise by the amount paid.

## How it is invoked

The fee is paid by the holder: the agent unlocks `pay_companion_phone_booking_fee_ff06513e` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

- `companion_id` — reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the booking was made on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup.
- `companion_ticket_number` — the companion's ticket number on the booking: 13 digits beginning 419, digits only with no spaces, exactly as shown on that booking's entry in the companion trip and charge history.
- `amount` — the phone booking fee being paid, in USD, a decimal number rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; zero allowed, never negative.

## Return

A receipt confirming the payment: `charge_entry_id`, `companion_id`, `companion_ticket_number`, `charge_component` (always `phone_booking_fee`), `amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places, the amount paid), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`payment_recorded` when the payment is on file). No error receipt is defined.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A run with an amount of 0.00 records the fee as settled at zero and returns `amount_usd` 0.0 with `status` `payment_recorded`.
